endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: wv_valley_falls_river_right_checkin valley-falls-state-park-river-right-checkin: American Whitewater states that the published put-in coordinates direct paddlers to the Valley Falls State Park office on river right for required sign-in, then instructs them to follow park directions to the river. The state park confirms kayaking is available. The stored point is the required park/check-in anchor, not water entry. Follow current park staff instructions, road conditions, and river-right access rules.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (wv_valley_falls_river_right_checkin valley-falls-state-park-river-right-checkin) on Tygart Valley River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.

endpoints.reach: Valley Falls State Park to Hammond / Twist and Shout take-out
endpoints.endpointName: Twist and Shout take-out under the railroad bridge
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: wv_american_whitewater_twist_and_shout_railroad_bridge_takeout_20260919 american-whitewater-valley-falls-twist-and-shout-takeout: American Whitewater's Valley Falls to Hammond reach identifies the lower take-out under the railroad bridge and publishes 39.40187,-80.09554, exactly matching the stored route coordinate. The same source and current route guidance warn that the bridge is active infrastructure and that the take-out requires inspection and a separate shuttle plan; historical access reports note possible gate/access changes. Treat this as a conditional whitewater take-out anchor, not unrestricted public parking or a surveyed wet-toe point. Never walk the rail line or assume current land access without day-of confirmation.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (wv_american_whitewater_twist_and_shout_railroad_bridge_takeout_20260919 american-whitewater-valley-falls-twist-and-shout-takeout) on Tygart Valley River / Glady Creek; access is conditional (Use only after current inspection and confirmation of legal land access, parking, carry path, and bridge-area restrictions. Do not walk the active railroad line or assume the historical take-out remains open.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.
